This is the public personal profile of Marcin Kukla (Wodzu): educator of natural development, consultant, mentor, second-generation entrepreneur, builder/craftsman, culture advocate, traveler, family father, founder of Oswobodzeni, and operator connected with Holiskool and Memphis. SPIN/IMPAKT are treated here as program/workstream terms, not as formal founder claims.

As of 2026, his commercial practice is organized under the planned sole proprietorship (JDG) **Załatwianie Spraw Marcin Kukla** (NIP 5521670042).
